blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Onboarding is the process of welcoming a new employee. It happens on the first day and during the first week.

On the first day, HR says "Welcome". They show the office and present the team. The new person learns where things are and how things work.

A good onboarding is friendly and organised. When people feel welcome, they start their job with confidence.

items.q: What is onboarding?
options: The process of welcoming a new employee
items.why: "Onboarding is the process of welcoming a new employee."

items.q: On the first day, what does HR do?
options: They ask the person to work alone
They say "Welcome", show the office and present the team
items.why: "HR says 'Welcome'. They show the office and present the team."

items.q: According to the text, a good onboarding is…
items.why: "A good onboarding is friendly and organised."

items.q: The text suggests that a new person who feels welcome will…
options: work only on the first day
items.why: Inferência: "When people feel welcome, they start their job with confidence."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: A warm welcome helps a new person.
The first day is part of onboarding.
HR shows the office to new people.
A confusing first day is good for new people.
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende um onboarding amigável e organizado — um primeiro dia confuso vai contra a mensagem.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily receber Bruno no primeiro dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Bruno, welcome to Czarnikow! I am Emily. We are very happy to have you here.

Come with me. First, take this badge — you will need it every day to enter the building. Keep it with you, please.

Now, look — this is your desk. It is next to the window. Sit here and make yourself comfortable. Your computer is ready, so check your email. The onboarding schedule for the week is there.

Let me introduce the team. This is Ana, and this is Carlos. They are your colleagues, and they are very kind. Ask them any question — no question is silly on the first day.

At one o'clock, join us for lunch. The team wants to meet you. And please, do not worry — the first day is always a lot of information. Take it slowly. If you need anything, come and find me. Have a great first day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Emily give Bruno first?
items.why: "take this badge — you will need it every day."

items.q: Where is Bruno's desk?
items.why: "this is your desk. It is next to the window."

items.q: What should Bruno check on his computer?
options: His email with the onboarding schedule
items.why: "check your email. The onboarding schedule for the week is there."

items.q: Emily says "no question is silly on the first day". This suggests that Bruno should…
options: wait one week to ask anything
items.why: Inferência: ela quer que Bruno se sinta à vontade para perguntar.

items.q: How would you best describe Emily's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela é amigável, calma e diz "do not worry" e "have a great first day".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We use onboarding to welcome every new person." Onboarding is…
options: the process of welcoming and integrating a new employee
items.why: Onboarding = integração de um novo colaborador.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Emily is friendly, so she will ___ Bruno to the team."
items.why: To introduce = apresentar alguém a outras pessoas.

items.q: "You need your badge to enter the building." A badge is…
options: an ID card you wear or use to enter
items.why: Badge = crachá, usado para identificação e entrada.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Ana sits at the next ___, so she is easy to talk to."
items.why: Desk = mesa de trabalho.

items.q: "After a good first day, Bruno started with confidence." Confidence means…
options: a feeling of being sure and calm
items.why: Confidence = confiança, sentir-se seguro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões comuns no primeiro dia de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Emily will show Bruno around the office." To show around means to…
options: take someone on a tour of a place
items.why: Show around = mostrar o lugar a alguém, dar um tour.

items.q: "Please fill in these documents at HR." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (formulários, documentos).

items.q: "Don't worry — you will soon settle in." To settle in means to…
options: become comfortable in a new place
items.why: Settle in = adaptar-se, sentir-se em casa num lugar novo.

items.q: "If you need help, reach out to me." To reach out means to…
options: ask someone for help or contact
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato, pedir ajuda.

items.q: "In one week you will get up to speed with the job." This means you will…
options: learn enough to do the job well
items.why: Get up to speed = ficar por dentro, dominar o que precisa para o trabalho.
